description:
Cosmo Care is a team driven by a passion for space, engineering, healthcare, and innovative technology. 🚀

For the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we aim to develop a smart software solution that continuously monitors astronauts’ health conditions, identifies potential health risks, and provides meaningful insights to support timely decision-making.

Our vision is simple: healthcare should go beyond Earth. 🌍🛰️
summary: We developed Cosmo Care, an autonomous, AI-driven health and psychological resilience platform engineered to safeguard astronauts during extended deep-space missions. As space exploration moves beyond Low Earth Orbit toward the Moon and Mars, severe communication delays and limited onboard medical staff make Earth-dependent healthcare impossible. Cosmo Care directly addresses this challenge by acting as a self-sustaining digital medical officer. The system pairs facial recognition login with emotion detection and an empathetic AI chatbot to monitor and stabilize crew mental health. Physiologically, it tracks vital metrics—including heart rate, blood pressure, and muscle strain—while processing simulated radiation telemetry to issue immediate safety countermeasures. To combat progressive microgravity-induced atrophy, Cosmo Care dynamically recalibrates daily exercise routines and diet plans based on the spacecraft's distance from Earth, exporting all medical reports as lightweight CSV files for asynchronous Mission Control review. By automating critical physical and psychological care, Cosmo Care reduces mission risk and ensures long-term crew survival and readiness.
details:
Project Overview: What Cosmo Care Does & How It Works

Cosmo Care is an all-in-one, autonomous health and psychological monitoring platform designed to empower astronauts to manage their own medical care during long-duration spaceflight. Without immediate access to Earth-based physicians due to communication blackouts and latency, the system functions as an intelligent, self-contained digital medical officer.

Core System Modules & Workflow

  • Biometric Login & Affective Computing: The workflow begins at authentication. Using the device camera, the system performs facial recognition to log the astronaut into their personalized medical profile. Simultaneously, it scans facial micro-expressions to evaluate emotional state, stress, and fatigue. If emotional imbalance or isolation stress is detected, an integrated AI Psychological Chatbot initiates interactive, supportive conversations to help maintain cognitive and emotional stability.
  • Simulated Radiation Telemetry & Countermeasures: Because live space-grade dosimeters cannot be physically demonstrated on Earth, Cosmo Care runs a simulated radiation telemetry engine. It continuously tracks ambient radiation levels (such as Solar Particle Events and Galactic Cosmic Rays) and automatically issues tiered, actionable safety instructions—ranging from routine shielding adjustments to immediate storm-shelter evacuation protocols.
  • Personalized Clinical Triage: Astronauts track both vital physiological telemetry (heart rate and blood pressure) and subjective physical symptoms (muscle aches, cramps, and localized pain). The triage engine evaluates these inputs against spaceflight baselines and provides immediate self-care protocols.
  • Distance-Adaptive Health & Diet Planner: As a spacecraft travels further from Earth, prolonged exposure to microgravity accelerates bone demineralization and muscle atrophy. CosmoCare calculates the vessel's distance from Earth (mission phase) and dynamically recalibrates the astronaut's daily resistance exercise regimens and nutritional intake to counteract specific physiological changes at that stage of the journey.
  • Daily Routine & Lightweight CSV Reporting: The platform organizes all scheduled check-ins, workouts, and meals into a structured Daily Health Routine. Every medical log and assessment is compiled and exported as a standardized CSV file, ensuring medical records require minimal bandwidth when transmitted asynchronously to Mission Control.

Key Benefits & Intended Impact

Core Benefits

  • Zero-Latency Medical Autonomy: Eliminates dangerous wait times for Earth-based medical consultations during deep-space communication delays (which can reach up to 44 minutes round-trip on Mars missions).
  • Holistic Mind-Body Integration: Treats psychological resilience and physical telemetry as a unified system rather than isolated metrics, preventing cognitive burnout alongside physical deconditioning.
  • Ultra-Low Bandwidth Footprint: By generating clean CSV medical reports instead of heavy proprietary database files, the system preserves critical spacecraft telemetry bandwidth.

Intended Impact

CosmoCare is built to de-risk the next era of human space exploration, including lunar habitats (Artemis) and Mars transit missions. By shifting crew healthcare from reactive, Earth-dependent monitoring to proactive, onboard self-sufficiency, the platform ensures astronauts remain healthy, sharp, and mission-ready. Furthermore, its offline-capable, autonomous triage architecture has direct terrestrial spin-off potential for remote environments on Earth—such as submarine crews, polar research stations, and rural disaster zones.

Technology Stack: Tools, Languages & Software

  • Frontend & User Interface: Built with Streamlit and Python to create an interactive, dark-mode telemetry dashboard optimized for low-eye-strain spacecraft environments—developed and prototyped with AI assistance from ChatGPT and Claude.
  • Backend & Logic Architecture: Powered by Gemini and LM Studio (for local LLM inference and offline autonomy) to run physiological triage logic, distance-based health planning algorithms, and simulated radiation data synthesis.
  • Computer Vision & AI: Vision & AI: Python, OpenCV, and scikit-learn (sklearn) for real-time facial recognition and emotion classification, paired with a conversational AI Psychological Chatbot powered by Grok via the OpenRouter API
  • Data Management & Hardware Interface: Standard webcam/optical sensor integration for facial scanning, and automated CSV file generation modules for local medical record archiving.

Creativity & Innovation: What Sets CosmoCare Apart

  • Distance-From-Earth Physiological Scaling: Most health apps use static baselines. CosmoCare innovates by tying diet and exercise regimens directly to the spacecraft's distance from Earth, recognizing that an astronaut in Low Earth Orbit has vastly different physiological countermeasure needs than one mid-transit to Mars.
  • Frictionless Passive Mental Health Screening: Astronauts are often reluctant to self-report psychological distress. By embedding emotional state checking directly into the mandatory facial recognition login, Cosmo Care captures accurate mental health trends passively and non-invasively every day.
  • Hardware-Agnostic Radiation Simulation: Using a realistic mathematical simulation engine to model radiation spikes allows the software to demonstrate high-stakes emergency triage workflows without requiring hazardous or expensive physical radiation sources.

Key Factors Considered by Our Team

  • Deep-Space Communication Constraints: We designed the entire system—including the AI bot, triage instructions, and CSV export—to function autonomously without relying on high-bandwidth cloud servers or real-time Earth connectivity.
  • Microgravity Physiology: We accounted for how fluid shifts, cardiovascular deconditioning, and musculoskeletal loss progress over time in zero-G, ensuring our health planner targets cramps, muscle aches, and blood pressure shifts accurately.
  • Crew Workload & Cognitive Fatigue: Astronauts operate on tightly packed schedules. We streamlined the interface into a clear Daily Health Routine with hands-free facial login so medical tracking takes seconds rather than hours.
  • Data Portability: Medical officers on Earth need raw, easily parsable data. Choosing CSV exports ensures universal compatibility with NASA and commercial mission control analytics pipelines.
